category: SEC Football — It Just Means More
prompt: What happened at the end of the 2013 Iron Bowl?
response:
**The Kick Six play ended the 2013 Iron Bowl.**

In the Iron Bowl on November 30, 2013, #1 Alabama led #4 Auburn 28–21 with 32 seconds left. After Auburn tied it at 28–28 with a 39-yard touchdown run by Tre Mason, Alabama drove to the Auburn 38-yard line. With 1 second left, Alabama kicker Adam Griffith attempted a 57-yard field goal.

The kick fell short. Auburn's Chris Davis, positioned deep as a returner, caught the ball in the end zone and returned it 109 yards for a touchdown as time expired—**the first and only walk-off touchdown return of a missed field goal in FBS history**.

**Final score: Auburn 34, Alabama 28.**

This play, nicknamed the “Kick Six,” gave Auburn the SEC West title and sent them to the SEC Championship (which they won). It’s widely regarded as one of the most dramatic endings in college football history.
